from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
for file in ['core/application_bundle_assembly.py','core/job_discovery.py','source_connectors/contract.py','core/non_submit_application_execution.py']:
 lines=(repo/file).read_text().splitlines()
 matches=[(i+1,line.strip()[:200]) for i,line in enumerate(lines) if 'application_url' in line or 'source_url' in line and 'url' in line]
 print('FILE',file,'URL_REFERENCES',matches[:35])
r=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_job_discovery.py','tests/test_job_search.py','tests/test_lever_source_connector.py','tests/test_greenhouse_source_connector.py'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=160)
print('TARGETED_URL_TEST_EXIT',r.returncode)
print(r.stdout[-5000:])
print(r.stderr[-700:])
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
